name: Vampire Sweetie
source:
In a certain quiet place on the outskirts of town, near the sea... Yuri worked as a caretaker of a white-walled mansion atop a hill in her father's absence.

One day, her father gave Yuri a phone call. Upon agreement after a business negotiation, her father had invited the business partner's sons to the mansion. Though angered by her father's selfish decision, Yuri liked the idea of a lively home so she had high hopes for the new residents.

"Hi. You're Yuri?"

Four good-looking brothers had appeared before Yuri.
The eldest Faust, who had a slightly suspicious aura.
The second eldest, Mikhail, who was refined and taciturn.
The friendly and cheerful third eldest Alon and youngest Joshua.

While Yuri was nervous because she didn't have much experience with men, 
she was still able to get along with the brothers because of her naturally cheerful personality.

One sleepless night, Yuri was suddenly confronted by Joshua biting into her neck and sucking her blood. It turned out that the brothers were an advanced vampire family that weren't affected by sunlight, crosses or garlic.

Yuri was stunned.
Ordinarily, they had to kill those who find out their true identities but since they got along with Yuri so well, they made a suggestion:

"We won't kill you but let us suck your blood in exchange." 

Aside from the blood-sucking, their lifestyles weren't much different from a group of good friends sharing a house. When they sucked her blood, they did so as considerately as possible, given that Yuri hadn't even held a guy's hand before. The sensation of their lips whenever they sucked her blood... The brothers held Yuri's blood in high regard, claiming it "very easy to drink".

Gradually, the darkness and past memories deep inside their hearts came to light.
And faint feelings shone from deep within her small chest.

From the moment Yuri realized those feelings were of "first love", the world had begun to change...

[Translation of official website plot summary.]
translation:
在城郊靠海的一處僻靜之地……父親不在時，悠莉負責照看山丘上一座白牆宅邸。

一天，父親打電話給悠莉。經過一場商務談判並達成協議後，他邀請了合作伙伴的幾個兒子來宅邸住。悠莉雖然對父親自作主張的決定感到生氣，卻也喜歡熱鬧的家庭，因此對新住客滿懷期待。

「你好。你就是悠莉？」

四名俊美兄弟出現在悠莉面前。
長子浮士德，身上帶著些許可疑氣息。
次子米哈伊爾，舉止優雅而沉默寡言。
還有友善開朗的三子阿隆和幼子約書亞。

悠莉沒有多少與男性相處的經驗，心中十分緊張；不過憑藉天生開朗的性格，她仍然與兄弟們融洽相處。

一個難以入眠的夜晚，約書亞突然咬住悠莉的脖子，吸食她的鮮血。原來，這四兄弟屬於高等吸血鬼家族，不會受到陽光、十字架或大蒜的影響。

悠莉驚呆了。
通常，他們必須殺死發現自己真實身分的人；但由於與悠莉相處得如此融洽，他們提出了一個建議：

「我們不會殺你，但作為交換，請允許我們吸你的血。」

除去吸血一事，他們的生活方式與一群好友合租並沒有太大區別。悠莉此前甚至從未牽過男生的手，所以他們吸血時會盡可能溫柔體貼。每當他們吸食她的鮮血，嘴唇帶來的觸感……兄弟們對悠莉的血評價極高，稱其「非常順口」。

漸漸地，他們內心深處的黑暗與往昔記憶浮出水面。
她小小的胸膛深處，也亮起了朦朧的情愫。

從悠莉意識到那份感情就是「初戀」的一刻起，世界開始改變……

[譯自官方網站的劇情簡介。]
